title: 修复 macOS 多窗口 Engine 消息错误并准备跨平台界面验收
objective: 修复或隔离 macOS 启动及多窗口生命周期中的 Invalid engine handle / Failed to send message to Flutter engine 错误，并为下一阶段 macOS→Windows 真实界面验收补齐可验证测试与报告资产。
agent_role: Codex 代码执行 agent；严格先复现/测试再修复；只修改允许路径；仅本地 commit；未经用户明确批准严禁 git push。

background.baseline: 执行前重新读取 git status、git branch -vv、git log --format='%h %p %ci %s' -12、真实 upstream ref；当前已知 HEAD=ce814fbc249bd3c36ca5ab41151bb29fe70cc980，origin/dev=dfdbc1dbf8db5e25b714309251fdd76a6efd4fc1，但若漂移以执行时实测为准。

observed_errors: Invalid engine handle appeared on both startups
Failed to send message to Flutter engine appeared on both startups
evidence.automation: Codex Computer Use window_read=PASS, screenshot=PASS, accessibility_click=BLOCKED, coordinate_click=BLOCKED; do not treat static window evidence as interaction evidence.
evidence.artifact: Existing Release bundle mtime 2026-08-27 predates current responsive HEAD ce814fb; old artifact is NOT_IN_ARTIFACT for responsive acceptance.

source_facts: AppDelegate.swift registers GeneratedPlugins and file_picker_bridge on main/child engines.
MainFlutterWindow.swift registers GeneratedPlugins on the main FlutterViewController.
MultiWindowManager.initialize subscribes to onWindowsChanged and calibrates category windows via WindowController.getAll().
app_bootstrap initializes MultiWindowManager only on main window path and shows child windows after a frame.
Current test search found navigation_policy_test.dart but no dedicated MultiWindowManager lifecycle test covering stale windows and engine-message safety.
AGENTS.md requires quality_gate after code changes and forbids unapproved git push.
Accessibility remains phase 2 and is out of scope.

design_decisions.title: reproduce_before_fix
design_decisions.rationale: The existing failure is a native/Flutter Engine boundary symptom; do not apply another timing workaround without a red-capable loop.
constraints: Read the exact current source and desktop_multi_window API before editing.
Create or extend a deterministic Dart seam for stale-window calibration, lifecycle ordering, or message broadcast safety where possible.
If the exact native error cannot be reproduced on the local host, state that explicitly and use source-level/test evidence; do not claim the native issue is fixed solely from flutter test.
acceptance: A regression test or explicit source-level invariant covers the selected root cause.
The report distinguishes reproduced, not reproduced, and platform-only observations.

design_decisions.title: engine_lifecycle_safety
design_decisions.rationale: Prevent messages or lifecycle callbacks from targeting stale/destroyed child engines while preserving three-category windows, same-category reuse, close/reopen, and child file picker registration.
constraints: Keep main and child GeneratedPlugin registration intact.
Keep file_picker_bridge channel registration for every relevant engine.
Do not replace desktop_multi_window with another package.
Do not change NavigationPolicy 600dp semantics or mobile in-app navigation.
Do not weaken the error check by filtering or suppressing target log strings.
acceptance: No stale category entry remains after calibration/close notification in the testable seam.
Same-category open reuses a live controller.
A closed/dead controller is not used as a live category window.
Native registration code remains present for main and child engines.

design_decisions.title: acceptance_handoff_macOS_first
design_decisions.rationale: macOS is the gating platform; Windows testing must start only after macOS evidence is sufficient.
constraints: Add or update only local acceptance assets under macos_acceptance/ if needed.
Do not modify existing historical notes.md or rewrite prior PASS/FAIL evidence.
Responsive UI acceptance requires a newly built artifact containing the current commit and is not satisfied by a stale Release bundle.
acceptance: A machine-readable next-stage report/checklist states MACOS_GATE=PASS or HOLD with explicit reasons.
The report contains the exact conditions required before Windows self-test.
No Windows-ready claim is emitted while macOS gate is HOLD.

design_decisions.title: local_commit_no_push
design_decisions.rationale: The user explicitly requires no remote push without separate approval.
constraints: git push, tag, Release, merge, force-push, and history rewrite are forbidden.
Do not include unrelated Windows/macOS documentation or pending task JSONs in the feature commit.
acceptance: origin/dev remains unchanged from task preflight.
Commit file list contains only allowed source/test/acceptance assets.

implementation_steps.detail: 核对实际 git 基线、upstream、工作区；读取目标模块 AI_ANALYSIS、AppDelegate.swift、MainFlutterWindow.swift、app_bootstrap.dart、multi_window_manager.dart、category_navigation.dart、相关测试和 notes/report；保留既有脏文件。
implementation_steps.verify: 记录 preflight baseline；若 HEAD/upstream 与 background 不同，以实测值更新执行报告；不得 reset/stash/删除无关文件。

implementation_steps.detail: 建立最小可运行复现/诊断：主窗口启动、一个/三个分类窗口、同类复用、关闭、重开、子窗口 file_picker；追踪 desktop_multi_window 的 onWindowsChanged、WindowController.getAll、窗口注册表和插件通道边界。若本地无法真实创建窗口，补充可执行的单元 seam 并明确 native reproduction unavailable。
implementation_steps.verify: 输出根因假设排序、支持证据、反证和可复现步骤；禁止先改代码。

implementation_steps.detail: 先增加/完善 MultiWindowManager 或等价边界测试，覆盖 stale controller 清理、同分类 live controller 复用、关闭后重开、无效窗口不复用；必要时为依赖建立最小可注入 seam，但不得改变业务 API 语义。
implementation_steps.verify: 测试真实运行；若当前实现已经通过，记录 already_safe 并说明测试覆盖的新增边界；若失败，保留失败输出。

implementation_steps.detail: 仅针对已证实根因实施最小修复；确保主/子 Engine GeneratedPlugins 和 file_picker_bridge 注册不丢失；不通过过滤日志、延迟任意消息或修改验收预期来伪造修复。
implementation_steps.verify: 定向回归测试通过；Swift/Dart diff 与 DD-2 一致。

implementation_steps.detail: 更新/新增下一阶段 macOS 界面验收机器可读报告模板，包含 artifact provenance、启动日志、三分类窗口、子窗口 file_picker、同类复用、关闭重开、Engine 错误、响应式视口及 MACOS_GATE；Windows 仅作为 macOS PASS 后的下一阶段，不在本任务执行。
implementation_steps.verify: 报告字段完整；旧历史报告不被改写；无 Windows PASS 或 windows_ready=true 的虚假结论。

implementation_steps.detail: 执行目标测试、flutter analyze、必要的 macOS debug/release build smoke（若宿主能力允许），再执行 bash tool/quality_gate.sh；将完整 gate 输出和本地 commit 文件清单记录；仅本地 commit，严禁 git push。
implementation_steps.verify: quality_gate 6/6；git show --name-status HEAD 仅允许文件；HEAD 更新而 origin/dev 不变；失败如实报告。
